a.note: today's behaviour under the app's configuration: sentence chunking, text-derived frame cap, codec silence stop, duration retry

b.note: a chunk never opens with a bracket cue: the cue and its sentence join the previous chunk

b2.note: a chunk never opens with a bracket cue: the cue ends the previous chunk, its sentence opens the next

c.note: the whole line as one chunk (the reference's 300-byte chunking)

d.note: the Space's sampling on today's chunking: temperature 1.0, top-p 0.9, top-k off

e.note: retry a chunk that stopped without eos, and stop a chunk whose main tokens cycle

f.note: cue text normalised: lowercase, no spaces inside brackets, opening styles mapped to the official tag list

g.note: a cap floor like the Space's: every chunk may run at least 8 s, and a slow or whisper direction multiplies the expected duration by 1.6

e2.note: e narrowed: retry a chunk that missed eos only when it spoke under 1.0 of its expected seconds, or when the loop guard stopped it

ge2.note: g plus e2: the cap floor with the narrowed eos retry and the loop guard

he2.note: e2 plus 1.5 s of cap per bracket cue instead of a floor

dhe2.note: the Space's sampling with he2: temperature 1.0, top-p 0.9, top-k off, cap per cue, narrowed eos retry, loop guard
